newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends higher after thin session.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends higher after thin session.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended marginally higher and near the day's ceiling in Friday's rangebound and thin trade.
Front-months May and August were the only contracts traded in the AA-dominated session, finishing at $308.50 and $307.00 per tonne respectively, up 50 and 40 cents.
May reached an intraday high of $308.80.
Turnover was a dull 864 lots, nearly all of which in May.
Trade selling counterbalanced broker buying and limited interest was reported in May/May and August/July arbitrage trades against the New York market, as both premiums remained approximatey in line.
